get_inside.text: Wilderness
There are five rifts that allow entrance to the Chaos Tunnels. These are located:
North of the Monastery of Saradomin in level 4 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with gargoyles.
East of the Mage of Zamorak in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with Giant Rock Crabs.
North of the Grand Exchange in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with shadow spiders and crypt spiders.
North of the bridge between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange in level 9 wilderness; enters a cave with moss giants.
North of the Grand Exchange beacon in level 9 wilderness; rift enters a cave with cave bugs.

During the quest What Lies Below, a safe route into the Chaos Tunnels is uncovered. Entering the statue south-west of the Fort Forinthry leads into the Tunnel of Chaos. From there, the nearest portal to the entrance, towards the north-west, can be used to teleport in to the south-east corner of the Chaos tunnels, a chamber containing giant ant soldiers.

get_inside.text: Taverley
The entrance to the caverns

The entrance to the dungeon is found south of Taverley and west of Falador. After the update Troll Warzone, it was relocated closer to a bank - directly south of the dock past the bridge by the wheat patch. (The boat carries to Daemonheim, and from there to Al Kharid or back to Taverley).

The Obelisk of Water on an island can only be reached by traversing the dungeon. The island is just off the coast near Catherby. There is a one-way mithril grapple shortcut from the island to the shore which requires 36 Agility, 39 Ranged, and 22 Strength.

get_inside.text: Karamja
The entrance to Brimhaven Dungeon
The dungeon is located a short distance north-west of the Karamja lodestone. There are also other ways to get there, which are generally obsolete since the introduction of the lodestone:
It be reached by sailing from East Ardougne to Brimhaven, for a fee of 30 coins, 15 with Karamja gloves 1 or for free with the ring of charos.
Another sea route can be taken from Port Sarim to Musa Point, for the same price. However, it is a much longer walk to the dungeon entrance from Musa Point than from Brimhaven.
Alternatively, players can charter a ship to get to Brimhaven (e.g. the Port Sarim-Brimhaven charter ship ride costs 1,600 coins).
Teleportation is also practical:
Players with level 99 Dungeoneering can use the Dungeoneering cape's perk to teleport to the Brimhaven Dungeon resource dungeon after having accessed it first through other means.
House Teleport if the player-owned house is on Karamja or a Brimhaven tablet if the player has completed Love Story.
Teleport to the Karamja lodestone, which is located directly south-east of the dungeon.
Spirit tree if the player can plant a spirit tree behind the Brimhaven Agility Arena.
Amulet of glory to Karamja, then run west then south.
Fairy ring CKR and then north to the dungeon.
Use of Tai Bwo Wannai Teleport scrolls, a reward from Treasure Trails.

The nearest bank, although the quest Shilo Village and 10 extra coins are required, is Shilo Village bank by using Hajedy's cart. However, one would normally teleport to a bank and return via the the Karamja lodestone.

get_inside.text: Kharidian Desert
Pollnivneach Teleport scroll takes user directly into the city.
pic: Northern side of the town with a magic carpet, house portal and a small obelisk

get_inside.text: Using the magic carpet network to one of two magic carpet stations in the city. South Pollnivneach is also one of the two destinations of the Monkey colony magic carpet route.
House Teleport, if players have their house portal in Pollnivneach, they can use the spell to reach their house and then exit through the portal.
Pollnivneach tablet, if the Love Story quest has been completed.
Ring of slaying, Slayer cape or Slayer master cape teleport to the house of slayer master Sumona.
The Mask of Mourning and Helm of Keening can teleport user to the Pollnivneach well.
The master camouflage outfit offers unlimited teleports to Pollnivneach, just north-east of the well.
Walking south/south-east from the Shantay Pass.
Using the ferryman, Portmaster Kags, in the south-western corner of the Menaphos Port district.
Other ways to reach the city indirectly. These methods first go to nearby locations to speed up the journey, and then use the above methods to reach Pollnivneach:

There are some fairy rings somewhat near Pollnivneach. Ring DLQ is in the Uzer Hunter area near Nardah; from there either use the Nardah carpet or walk north-west to the upper river bridge, cross it and then walk south-west to the city. Ring BIQ is near the entrance to the Kalphite Lair; from there use the Shantay Pass carpet or walk east/south-east to the city.

The eagle transport system flies to a cave near the Uzer Hunter area, like the fairy ring DLQ. From there, either walk south-east to Uzer and use the carpet, or walk south-west to the upper river bridge, cross it and walk south-west to Pollnivneach.
The Dorgesh-Kaan shortcut in the dungeon beneath the agility course leads to the Kalphite Lair and from there has the same routes as Fairy Ring code BIQ.
The camulet from Enakhra's Lament teleports to the underground Enakhra's Temple. Climb out from there and walk east to the city.

The Pharaoh's sceptre from the Pyramid Plunder minigame teleports to any of three pyramids: Jalsavrah Pyramid is in Sophanem; from there take the carpet or walk north to Pollnivneach. Jaleustrophos Pyramid is the Agility Pyramid; from there either walk northeast to Nardah and take the carpet, or walk north-west to the lower river bridge, cross it and walk north to Pollnivneach. Jaldraocht Pyramid is also called Azzanadra's pyramid from the Desert Treasure quest; from there walk east or northeast to Pollnivneach.
West of Pollnivneach

place.title: Wilderness
place.summary: The Wilderness is infamous for being arguably the most perilous area in all of Gielinor. The terrain is mostly charred and barren, gradually progressing from sparsely wooded areas to volcanic terrain to a frozen wasteland as the player travels north. The Wilderness is inhabited by many different foes that generally become stronger in the deeper areas, including thugs, zombies, grizzly bears, and hill giants, as well as more powerful creatures such as demons, dragons, dark beasts, and glacors. Most of the monsters in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, can attack in groups and follow players quite far from their habitat, so caution should be taken when running past groups of dangerous monsters. The main appeal of the Wilderness is that it offers many lucrative combat and skilling opportunities, albeit with greater risk of death.

Other ways to reach the city indirectly. These methods first go to nearby locations to speed up the journey, and then use the above methods to reach Pollnivneach:

There are some fairy rings somewhat near Pollnivneach. Ring DLQ is in the Uzer Hunter area near Nardah; from there either use the Nardah carpet or walk north-west to the upper river bridge, cross it and then walk south-west to the city. Ring BIQ is near the entrance to the Kalphite Lair; from there use the Shantay Pass carpet or walk east/south-east to the city.

The eagle transport system flies to a cave near the Uzer Hunter area, like the fairy ring DLQ. From there, either walk south-east to Uzer and use the carpet, or walk south-west to the upper river bridge, cross it and walk south-west to Pollnivneach.
The Dorgesh-Kaan shortcut in the dungeon beneath the agility course leads to the Kalphite Lair and from there has the same routes as Fairy Ring code BIQ.
The camulet from Enakhra's Lament teleports to the underground Enakhra's Temple. Climb out from there and walk east to the city.

The Pharaoh's sceptre from the Pyramid Plunder minigame teleports to any of three pyramids: Jalsavrah Pyramid is in Sophanem; from there take the carpet or walk north to Pollnivneach. Jaleustrophos Pyramid is the Agility Pyramid; from there either walk northeast to Nardah and take the carpet, or walk north-west to the lower river bridge, cross it and walk north to Pollnivneach. Jaldraocht Pyramid is also called Azzanadra's pyramid from the Desert Treasure quest; from there walk east or northeast to Pollnivneach.

ml.text: The bandit king is the leader of a small group of desert bandits who seem to hide under the sand and ambush passers-by. During Diamond in the Rough, upon reaching the sundial of Apmeken, the Kharid-ib diamond makes a noise and possesses the king, causing him to command an ambush. Speaking through him, it demands to be brought back to Al Kharid Palace, but Ozan refuses. The diamond leaves the king's mind and, first confused, he orders his underlings to attack Ozan and his companion. He is killed in the following fight.

get_inside.text: The humble gate to the city
pic: The humble gate to the city

get_inside.text: There are multiple ways of accessing Dorgesh-Kaan.

Players may enter the crack in the eastern wall of the cellar of Lumbridge Castle, through which Kazgar waits to lead players through the Dorgesh-Kaan mine. The entrance to Dorgesh-Kaan is just to the south-east of where Kazgar leaves the player. To follow Kazgar through the mines, the player is required to bring a light source.
The city can be accessed from the Kalphite Hive through the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon to the south of the city, although a light source is required.

There is a fairy ring in the dungeon to the south with the code AJQ. This may only be used if players have completed A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen up to the point where the fairy ring network is unlocked. A light source is needed in the dungeon. To exit from the dungeon to the city, go east of the ring, then go north, west and again to north until a ladder. Climb up the ladder to the Dorgesh-Kaan course, and climb down the stairs to the north to reach the southern part of the city.

The Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system may be used to travel to Dorgesh-Kaan from Keldagrim by rail (after Another Slice of H.A.M.), and vice versa. The tickets are free; a player need only wait less than a minute in the carriage for the departure. The train station in Keldagrim is located near the blast furnace in the south-east of the city, and the train station in Dorgesh-Kaan is on the floor 2 in the south-west corner of the city.
A player may use a Dorgesh-kaan sphere, obtained from Oldak by giving him molten glass and 2 law runes, for a one-click teleport to the city.

place.title: Misthalin
place.summary:
Most of the population outside the capital consists of farmers and other such people who labour in the wealth of the breadbasket of Misthalin, which is concentrated in the south. This effectively splits the kingdom's community in two.
Cquote2 | Misthalin is a nation split quite evenly in two. The population outside Varrock is predominantly agricultural, and provides a great deal of food for the capital and for sale to other, poorer nations. The people of the capital, though, are largely tradesmen and artisans, who work with raw materials to produce something more immediately useful. This split in society may seem to work effectively, but the problem can be seen most clearly in the southern parts of Varrock. This is where the rural citizens who have come to the capital frequently end up, unskilled and naive, living off scraps and dressing in the rags of clothes discarded by the wealthy. | Game Guide

place.title: Bandos's Tower
place.summary: Not much of the tower remains today, with a large crater residing on its site, with a hole similar to a divination spot residing in the centre. Ruins of the tower and the Scarecrow can be found strewn around it. Goutbones the goblin can be found just outside, who will happily speak about the world event and allow you to re-watch the cutscenes. Bandos's destroyed head can be found just south of the tower, which can be prayed at to restore prayer points.

ml.name: Wilderness Warbands
ml.text: A Bandosian wild mage was a follower of Bandos that could be encountered during Wilderness Warbands. They primarily attacked their targets with magic, using the spell Fire Surge and various abilities. They wielded staves but their standard attacks were as fast as they would have been with a wand. In addition, they frequently used potent threshold abilities such as Asphyxiate and Wild Magic, and even ultimates such as Omnipower. For this reason, they were considered among the deadliest of the monsters at the Bandos camp, behind only their leader, the Bandosian warlord.

place.title: Slayer Tower
place.summary: As time passed, the other generals came to forget Viggora's Folly, but this only enticed Viggora to enlarge his fortress to earn their respect for humans. He planned to add more floors, make deeper dungeons and fortify the surrounding land. However, one day he returned to find the fortress had begun to sink into the swamp, as the ground had not been treated for such a massive project and that the dungeons were already flooding. This convinced Viggora that its nickname was well earned and that he was now completely humiliated.

Mort Myre Swamp, once a forest known as Humblethorn, is a swampland in western Morytania. It is a place plagued by Ghasts. Therefore, not even a full inventory of food will keep players safe here, because ghasts will decompose any kind of food. It is highly recommended for a player to carry a druid pouch with them as they travel through here. It can only be obtained during the Nature Spirit quest. Completing the quest is also a requirement to gain access to the gate shortcut. Dwarf multicannons cannot be set up in this area.

The shortcut located south-east from the entrance to Tarn's Lair.

get_inside.text: There is no direct path to the mine; the fastest method to reach the entrance is to use a Games necklace or Drakan's medallion to teleport to Burgh de Rott and run west. Otherwise, players must travel through Mort Myre Swamp.
Map:Abandoned Mine surface

The mine can be approached from the Mort Myre Swamp to the north. Level 61 feral vampyres infest this path. Follow the mine cart tracks to find the main entrance. Most mine carts can simply be walked around, although one cart near the entrance itself must be climbed over. There are also two cart tunnels near the River Salve, where part of the mine cart tracks temporarily leave the mine. All three of these entrances go to level 1.

There is also a set of stairs to the level 2 of the mine. However, both doors to this room are locked and require the crystal mine key to be unlocked. The player acquires this key during the Haunted Mine quest.

For those who have aided Burgh de Rott in the quest In Aid of the Myreque, a new path opens to the east. Jumping over the low fence (25 Agility required) will bring the player near the mine. Just run west a little and then choose your entrance.
Quick-access (pictured right): This only applies if players have completed the Morytania hard tasks and the Haunted Mine quest.
Enter the mine via the main entrance (climb the cart and through the tunnel) and select Crawl-through option on the tunnel at the cart immediately south.
Players who have not completed the hard Morytania achievements and Haunted Mine quest must follow the steps below to obtain the glowing fungus to gain access.
To get to point L on level 4 from the surface (and move a glowing fungus by mine cart):
# Surface: Enter the main entrance.
# Level 1: Go 1 - 3 - 4; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 4 - 6; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 6 - 12; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 12 - J (get fungus) - central K (put fungus in cart) - L. Also go M and N as necessary to set switches correctly. Push 'Start' at L.
To get to point 10 on level 4 from point L (to get the glowing fungus after moving it):
# Level 4: Go L - 12; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 12 - 6; climb up.
# Level 2: Go 6 - 4; climb up.
# Level 1: Go 4 - 3 - 2; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 2 - 7; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 7 - 10; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 10 - K (search cart for fungus).
To get to point 13 on level 5 from point K on level 4 (to get to the mine/collect key):
#Level 4: Go K - 10; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 10 - 9; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 9 - 13; take lift down to level 5.
To get a new crystal-mine key (skip to next group if you have the key):
# Level 5: Go 14; climb down.
# Level 6: Go 14 - T (take innocent-looking key; turns into crystal-mine key, can be added to the key ring).
#Level 6: Go 14; climb up to get back to level 5.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: There is no direct path to the mine; the fastest method to reach the entrance is to use a Games necklace or Drakan's medallion to teleport to Burgh de Rott and run west. Otherwise, players must travel through Mort Myre Swamp.

getting_there.heading: Entrance
getting_there.text:
Map:Abandoned Mine surface 
The mine can be approached from the Mort Myre Swamp to the north. Level 61 feral vampyres infest this path. Follow the mine cart tracks to find the main entrance. Most mine carts can simply be walked around, although one cart near the entrance itself must be climbed over. There are also two cart tunnels near the River Salve, where part of the mine cart tracks temporarily leave the mine. All three of these entrances go to level 1.

There is also a set of stairs to the level 2 of the mine. However, both doors to this room are locked and require the crystal mine key to be unlocked. The player acquires this key during the Haunted Mine quest.

For those who have aided Burgh de Rott in the quest In Aid of the Myreque, a new path opens to the east. Jumping over the low fence (25 Agility required) will bring the player near the mine. Just run west a little and then choose your entrance.

getting_there.heading: Accessing the crystal mine
getting_there.text:
Quick-access (pictured right): This only applies if players have completed the Morytania hard tasks and the Haunted Mine quest.
• Enter the mine via the main entrance (climb the cart and through the tunnel) and select Crawl-through option on the tunnel at the cart immediately south.

Players who have not completed the hard Morytania achievements and Haunted Mine quest must follow the steps below to obtain the glowing fungus to gain access.

To get to point L on level 4 from the surface (and move a glowing fungus by mine cart):
# Surface: Enter the main entrance.
# Level 1: Go 1 - 3 - 4; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 4 - 6; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 6 - 12; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 12 - J (get fungus) - central K (put fungus in cart) - L. Also go M and N as necessary to set switches correctly. Push 'Start' at L.

To get to point 10 on level 4 from point L (to get the glowing fungus after moving it):
# Level 4: Go L - 12; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 12 - 6; climb up.
# Level 2: Go 6 - 4; climb up.
# Level 1: Go 4 - 3 - 2; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 2 - 7; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 7 - 10; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 10 - K (search cart for fungus).

To get to point 13 on level 5 from point K on level 4 (to get to the mine/collect key):

#Level 4: Go K - 10; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 10 - 9; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 9 - 13; take lift down to level 5.

To get a new crystal-mine key (skip to next group if you have the key):

# Level 5: Go 14; climb down.
# Level 6: Go 14 - T (take innocent-looking key; turns into crystal-mine key, can be added to the key ring).
#Level 6: Go 14; climb up to get back to level 5.

To get to the crystal mine (with the crystal-mine key):
# Level 5: Go 15; climb down.
# Level 6: Go 15 - U (unlock door with key) - Y (crystal mine).

place.title: Slayer Tower
place.summary: As time passed, the other generals came to forget Viggora's Folly, but this only enticed Viggora to enlarge his fortress to earn their respect for humans. He planned to add more floors, make deeper dungeons and fortify the surrounding land. However, one day he returned to find the fortress had begun to sink into the swamp, as the ground had not been treated for such a massive project and that the dungeons were already flooding. This convinced Viggora that its nickname was well earned and that he was now completely humiliated.

place.title: Haunted Woods
place.summary: The Haunted Woods consist of a large, mostly dead and swampy vampyre-infested forest which covers a large portion of Morytania. It is located east of Canifis. It is the home of leeches, vampyres and hollow trees. There is a grave in the woods that must be found as a part of the Creature of Fenkenstrain quest. There is a fairy ring (code ALQ) south of the Port Phasmatys farming patch for quick access to Zanaris.

place.summary: Sinkholes are a Distraction and Diversion involving Dungeoneering, which is for members only. They take place outside Daemonheim at 30 minutes past every hour, in resource dungeons that were once used by Bilrach as storage rooms - these are scattered across Gielinor and the Gorajo have since found them. Their name is derived from a dangerous creature native to the Gorajo realm.

ml.name: The Zamorakian Undercity
ml.text: The Berserk Archaeologist is a miniboss within the Zamorakian Undercity. He uses a "Scroll of Animate Fred" to summon Fred to assist him. After he drops below 50% life points, he throws Archaeology Journal - H.F.A at players as an attack, dealing over 5,000 magic damage, which can be picked up afterwards for the Madness and Malediction achievement, even if killed in story mode. If fought in a group, only the player hit by the attack will be able to see and pick up the book. If the player hit is being intercepted, the book will not appear. Players looking for the book should stop attacking him after he reaches half health and wait for him to throw the book as players can kill him before he throws it.

get_inside.text: The entrance to the dungeon is located east of the pulley, which is used to enter Senntisten behind the Ancient door just north of the Archaeology Guild.
Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
Use the Pontifex Shadow Ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, to teleport to Senntisten, run north to the Pulley.

Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door (dungeon), east to the ancient doors (The Empty Throne Room) or north-east to a winch (Senntisten Temple).
Using a gnome glider to fly to Lemanto Andra (3) leaves the player very close to the ancient door.

The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 Archaeology or access to those items.
Dig site pendant can be used to teleport to the following:
Varrock Dig Site - Archaeologist's workbench & Bank chest, walk north-west to the ancient door.
Senntisten Temple - north-west winch entrance to temple.
Skeletal horror Teleport or invitation box can be used to teleport to the north-east of the ancient door.
Teleport to Earth altar, or using Fort Forinthry Teleport to the north-west of the ancient door.
Ride the balloon to Varrock to the north-west of the ancient door.

Use the Ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select The Zamorakian Undercity (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).
Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside Temple of Aminishi, The Shadow Reef, or the Dragonkin Laboratory (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).

place.title: The Zamorakian Undercity
place.summary: While it is considered an Elite Dungeon (with its own luck charms and ability to teleport to the other Elite Dungeons) it is noticeably different compared to the previous three; the health of enemies scales to the party size (and are also more dangerous) and its luck charm costs slightly more and cannot be converted. It also possesses an enrage system that goes up in intervals of 100% past 4,000% enrage, and the enemies' strengths, types, and quantities begin to change as it increases, capping at 60,000%. Players are free to choose their enrage from 0 to 4,000%. Clearing the undercity increases the rewards obtained from Zamorak.

get_inside.text: Baxtorian Lake

The whirlpool entrance to the Ancient Cavern is south of the Barbarian Outpost, at the head of the River Dougne, above Baxtorian Falls. Players can get there by walking west from Seers' Village, north from East Ardougne, or east from the Tree Gnome Stronghold. (From the Stronghold, players with level 37 Agility can take the shortcut northeast of the Grand Tree; otherwise, the more round-about route through the Stronghold's southern gate is necessary.)
Some teleports can be used to get near the whirlpool:
A games necklace can teleport to the Barbarian Outpost. This is quickest way to get to the whirlpool, as it is just south of the Outpost.
A combat bracelet can teleport to the Ranging Guild, which is east of Baxtorian Falls.
Barbarian Teleport from the Lunar Spellbook. Teleporting between the Barbarian Outpost and Lunar Isle provides quick banking during slayer tasks.
A plain of mud sphere can teleport one near the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
A skills necklace can teleport to the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
Players with level 37 Agility can use the gnome gliders or spirit trees to travel to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and then use the shortcut north of the Grand Tree to get to the Baxtorian Falls lake.
Three teleports can be used to directly enter the dungeon:
Fairy ring code BJQ, which will teleport near the north-western most waterfiends, once it is repaired as described earlier.

The ferocious ring, which is a drop from the creatures in Kuradal's Dungeon, can teleport the player to Kuradal (Note: you can only attack the monsters in the dungeon if they are your current Slayer assignment assigned by Kuradal, Morvran, or Laniakea.)
The Slayer cape can be used to teleport the player to Kuradal.
Partial completion of AchievementIcon | Barbarian Firemaking

pic: White Wolf Mountain — Asgarnia and Kandarin border

start_overview: White Wolf Mountain — Asgarnia and Kandarin border

get_inside.text: Asgarnia and Kandarin border
To traverse the exterior of the mountain:

Travel via the Gnome glider network to the Sindarpos location, which takes you to the east of the cave that leads to Catherby as well as a Hidey-hole location for one of the Treasure trail (hard) emote clues. Completion of The Grand Tree quest is required to use the gliders. To reach the cave entrance that leads back to Taverley, run north.

Home Teleport to the Taverley lodestone then run south and then north around the bank. Follow the path past the Land of Snow portal (used in the Violet is Blue quest) to your west until your reach a cave entrance. Entering the cave at the end of the path will take you to the area with wolves, Gnome glider, and cave entrance to Catherby.

Home teleport to the Catherby lodestone then run east past the fishing area on the beach then north. Follow that path to the cave entrance that will take you to the area with wolves, Gnome glider, and cave entrance to Taverley.
To traverse the interior of the mountain (requires completion of Fishing Contest quest):

To go from Taverley to Catherby: Enter the cave entrance directly to the north of the Taverley Player-owned house portal. Following the underground passage will lead to a cave exit just east of the Catherby farming patch.
To go from Catherby to Taverley: Enter the cave entrance to the east of the Catherby farming patch. Follow the underground path which exits just north of the Taverley Player-owned house portal.
White Wolf Mountain

place.title: White Wolf Mountain
place.summary: The mountain itself is very dangerous to low-level players, however there are a variety of ways to go around. Once a player has completed the Fishing Contest Quest, a tunnel that travels underneath the mountain becomes accessible (although it requires them to cross the mountain otherwise at least once). This tunnel features a cart station that leads to Keldagrim. There is also various affordable teleportation jewellery that can land players beyond the mountain, including games necklace and ring of duelling, and a boat from Port Sarim to Catherby; Catherby has a lodestone so the mountain only needs to be 'crossed' once.

get_inside.text: Wilderness
There are five rifts that allow entrance to the Chaos Tunnels. These are located:
North of the Monastery of Saradomin in level 4 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with gargoyles.
East of the Mage of Zamorak in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with Giant Rock Crabs.
North of the Grand Exchange in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with shadow spiders and crypt spiders.
North of the bridge between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange in level 9 wilderness; enters a cave with moss giants.
North of the Grand Exchange beacon in level 9 wilderness; rift enters a cave with cave bugs.

During the quest What Lies Below, a safe route into the Chaos Tunnels is uncovered. Entering the statue south-west of the Fort Forinthry leads into the Tunnel of Chaos. From there, the nearest portal to the entrance, towards the north-west, can be used to teleport in to the south-east corner of the Chaos tunnels, a chamber containing giant ant soldiers.

The Chaos Tunnels are a large dungeon network located in low-level Wilderness, north of Edgeville. It is in a members-only region. It does not require any quests to be accessed. If players attempt to exit the Chaos Tunnels while opted into PvP, they will receive a warning prompt about it before they can continue.

getting_there.heading: Entrances
getting_there.text:
There are five rifts that allow entrance to the Chaos Tunnels. These are located:
• North of the Monastery of Saradomin in level 4 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with gargoyles.
• East of the Mage of Zamorak in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with Giant Rock Crabs.
• North of the Grand Exchange in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with shadow spiders and crypt spiders.
• North of the bridge between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange in level 9 wilderness; enters a cave with moss giants.
• North of the Grand Exchange beacon in level 9 wilderness; rift enters a cave with cave bugs.

During the quest What Lies Below, a safe route into the Chaos Tunnels is uncovered. Entering the statue south-west of the Fort Forinthry leads into the Tunnel of Chaos. From there, the nearest portal to the entrance, towards the north-west, can be used to teleport in to the south-east corner of the Chaos tunnels, a chamber containing giant ant soldiers.

get_inside.text: The main entrance to the caves is through the Lumbridge Swamp, located south of Lumbridge. It is located in the centre of the swamp with a icon on the minimap. A rope is required when using this entrance for the first time. The Water altar is near this entrance.

Another route is through the basement of Lumbridge Castle, as the tunnels between the castle and the Dorgesh-Kaan mine also deviate towards the Swamp Caves, directly south from the tunnel entrance in the castle basement. The route between the tunnels and the Swamp Caves is initially blocked and needs to be mined. The Lost Tribe is required to access the tunnels and thus access the Swamp Caves from this direction.
A final route is via teleporting to the Tears of Guthix cavern with a games necklace then heading north.

place.title: Sophanem
place.summary: Sophanem was founded in the Second Age, shortly before the reign of Pharaoh Queen Senliten. It remained a relatively small village well into the Third Age, at which point the Kharidian Desert Campaign forced refugees from besieged settlements such as Uzer and Ullek to flee further south for survival. This re-location of most of the desert's populace essentially left Sophanem at the Menaphite nation's centre, eventually leading to its incorporation as part of a joint-capital with Menaphos.

get_inside.text: Cleanup | The following methods all refer to the same boatman/ferryman; please restate them concisely.

Start at the Grand Exchange, go north-west and travel to Keldagrim through the Keldagrim trapdoor. Then run north until seeing a bridge. Cross it and go south past the Kelda hops patch in front of the Consortium's western entrance until getting to the Stonemason's hut, then go east until reaching a small tower-like building. Open the door, go through, and follow the southern path and cross the bridge. Once over the bridge, run west until seeing a tunnel (completion of Forgiveness of a Chaos Dwarf is needed). Enter the tunnel and arrive at the battlefield with level 48-92 enemies. The chaos dwarves will only become aggressive if you initiate combat against one of them, excluding the non-aggressive dwogres.

Using the Grand Exchange method listed above, one can also take a shortcut by utilising the palace that gaps the river. Simply enter the palace, go up the stairs, run over the river, go down the stairs, then leave the palace. This shortens the walk/run by about 30 seconds to a minute.

Using the Grand Exchange method there is actually a shorter way than the above method. When arriving from the Grand Exchange by cart, run to the north just past the consortium until you see a boat and a man standing next to it aptly called "Boatman" click on him and allow him to take you to the mines. Once you arrive where he takes you right click a nearby dwarf named "Ferryman" and choose the cross river option. This will put you right by the entrance to the Chaos Battlefield.

A quicker method to the battlefield is to teleport to Rellekka with an enchanted lyre or using teleport to home if your house is in Rellekka, then running northeast to the entrance to Keldagrim. Upon entering use the Dwarven Boatman and then right-clicking the Dwarven Ferryman and selecting "Cross-river." From there you can run west to the tunnel. This allows you to get back to your grave before 5 minutes have passed.

Access fairy ring DKS and run down the hill to the Keldagrim entrance. Enter Keldagrim after which you right-click the Dwarven Ferryman and select "Cross-river". From there you can run north and west to the tunnel entrance to the Chaos Dwarf Battlefield.

Another method similar to the above involves using an Ardougne cloak to teleport to the Kandarin Monastery to recharge your prayer, and either using a slayer ring to teleport to the Rellekka Slayer cave, or running to the fairy ring by the Tower of Life.

One of the fastest methods to get there is to cast the Home Teleport spell to the Fremennik Province lodestone, then running north-east to the Keldagrim entrance. Go through the entrance, through the crack in the wall, cross the river, and make your way over to the secret door which leads to the battlefield.

get_inside.text: The entrance to Keldagrim
First time from the Keldagrim entrance tunnel east of Rellekka.
The Luck of the Dwarves or Hazelmere's signet ring provide unlimited teleports to the west side of the Palace floor 1.

Players with access to Keldagrim can use the Keldagrim trapdoor in the north-west of the Grand Exchange to arrive in East Keldagrim. A luck ring such as the Ring of Wealth or higher variants can also teleport a short distance from the trapdoor using the Grand Exchange teleport option.

The master camouflage outfit provides unlimited teleports to the Consortium (0, 1), the top floor of the palace in the centre of Keldagrim. This allows convenient access to both the east and west side of Keldagrim. Other variants of this outfit will also teleport players to this location five times per day.
Players may buy a one-way rail cart ticket to Keldagrim from one of the cart conductors in the Dwarven Mine under White Wolf Mountain or a free train ride from Dorgesh-Kaan.

Players may also use the Fremennik Province lodestone, run north-east, and enter the cave entrance to the east with two statues. Once inside, there is another entrance with two statues directly in front of the player. Enter this, ignoring the long path.

Players who have level 99 in at least one skill, or are able to wear the Quest Cape can tune the skill portal in Max Guild to the Lava Flow Mine. The portal will teleport the player right next to the entrance to the city. It requires completion of King of the Dwarves.

ml.name: Dwarven Mine entrance

get_inside.text: Asgarnia
Main entrance: In the foothills of the Ice Mountain, north of the Falador to Gunnarsgrunn road. Using a combat bracelet to teleport to the Edgeville Monastery is a quick way to get to this entrance.
Falador entrance: A building in the far northeast of Falador has stairs down to the south end of the mine. A Falador Teleport is a fast way to get here and to get to the next entrance.
South gate: Entrance to the Mining Guild, level 60 Mining required.

Mine cart: Members may use the Keldagrim minecart system to enter the mine in the north-west section. This two-way network allows players to travel between the Dwarven Mine and the bustling dwarven capital of Keldagrim. From the cart station in Keldagrim, it is also possible to travel to White Wolf Mountain and the Grand Exchange, provided that the quest Fishing Contest has been completed. One fast way to get to the mine is to take the carts from the Grand Exchange to Keldagrim and then to Ice Mountain. Also, the train station in Keldagrim is next to the carts and thus allows access from Dorgesh-Kaan, provided that the Another Slice of H.A.M. quest has been completed.
After completing the Perils of Ice Mountain quest, a trapdoor route becomes available within the Power Station next to Ice Mountain. It leads to Nurmof's room.

get_inside.text: Cleanup | The following methods all refer to the same boatman/ferryman; please restate them concisely.

Start at the Grand Exchange, go north-west and travel to Keldagrim through the Keldagrim trapdoor. Then run north until seeing a bridge. Cross it and go south past the Kelda hops patch in front of the Consortium's western entrance until getting to the Stonemason's hut, then go east until reaching a small tower-like building. Open the door, go through, and follow the southern path and cross the bridge. Once over the bridge, run west until seeing a tunnel (completion of Forgiveness of a Chaos Dwarf is needed). Enter the tunnel and arrive at the battlefield with level 48-92 enemies. The chaos dwarves will only become aggressive if you initiate combat against one of them, excluding the non-aggressive dwogres.

Using the Grand Exchange method listed above, one can also take a shortcut by utilising the palace that gaps the river. Simply enter the palace, go up the stairs, run over the river, go down the stairs, then leave the palace. This shortens the walk/run by about 30 seconds to a minute.

Using the Grand Exchange method there is actually a shorter way than the above method. When arriving from the Grand Exchange by cart, run to the north just past the consortium until you see a boat and a man standing next to it aptly called "Boatman" click on him and allow him to take you to the mines. Once you arrive where he takes you right click a nearby dwarf named "Ferryman" and choose the cross river option. This will put you right by the entrance to the Chaos Battlefield.

A quicker method to the battlefield is to teleport to Rellekka with an enchanted lyre or using teleport to home if your house is in Rellekka, then running northeast to the entrance to Keldagrim. Upon entering use the Dwarven Boatman and then right-clicking the Dwarven Ferryman and selecting "Cross-river." From there you can run west to the tunnel. This allows you to get back to your grave before 5 minutes have passed.

Access fairy ring DKS and run down the hill to the Keldagrim entrance. Enter Keldagrim after which you right-click the Dwarven Ferryman and select "Cross-river". From there you can run north and west to the tunnel entrance to the Chaos Dwarf Battlefield.

Another method similar to the above involves using an Ardougne cloak to teleport to the Kandarin Monastery to recharge your prayer, and either using a slayer ring to teleport to the Rellekka Slayer cave, or running to the fairy ring by the Tower of Life.

One of the fastest methods to get there is to cast the Home Teleport spell to the Fremennik Province lodestone, then running north-east to the Keldagrim entrance. Go through the entrance, through the crack in the wall, cross the river, and make your way over to the secret door which leads to the battlefield.
Chaos Dwarf Battlefield

place.title: Chaos Dwarf Battlefield
place.summary: The main attraction of this dungeon is the dragon pickaxe, which players can obtain from killing the Red Axe dwarves as a very rare drop. Other items that attract players are the hand cannon, a powerful 2-handed ranged weapon, and its ammo, the hand cannon shot.

get_inside.text: Taverley
The entrance to the caverns

The entrance to the dungeon is found south of Taverley and west of Falador. After the update Troll Warzone, it was relocated closer to a bank - directly south of the dock past the bridge by the wheat patch. (The boat carries to Daemonheim, and from there to Al Kharid or back to Taverley).

The Obelisk of Water on an island can only be reached by traversing the dungeon. The island is just off the coast near Catherby. There is a one-way mithril grapple shortcut from the island to the shore which requires 36 Agility, 39 Ranged, and 22 Strength.
Taverley Dungeon

place.title: Taverley Dungeon
place.summary: The dungeon has the entrances of two resource dungeons: the hellhound and blue dragon resource dungeon. These require 55 and 60 minimum Dungeoneering levels to enter, respectively. The blue dragon chamber of the dungeon and the resource dungeon accessed from this chamber are the only locations where blue dragon scales (used for Herblore) spawn.

get_inside.text: Misthalin
Varrock lodestone is located by the south gate.

Varrock Teleport or the teletab teleports to the main square. The destination can be changed to southern Grand Exchange entrance (requires Easy Varrock achievements) or north-east church (requires Elite Varrock achievements).
A Grand Exchange Teleport, ring of wealth, ring of fortune, or luck of the dwarves can be used to teleport to the Grand Exchange.

Varrock has four main gates, all of which are open to the public. Each is guarded by several level 36 guards, although they are not aggressive. The north gate can be found near the Wilderness wall and is commonly used by those travelling to Wilderness Crater or exploring the Wilderness. The east gate can be found after following the northern path at the crossroads near northern Al Kharid. The west gate can be reached by travelling east from Gunnarsgrunn. The south gate can be reached by travelling north-west from Lumbridge. Near it is the Stone Circle, where many level 7 and 20 dark wizards can be found.
Varrock east entrance.png | Varrock east entrance
Varrock south entrance.png | Varrock south entrance
Varrock north entrance.png | Varrock north gate

There are also several other less-official entrances. By travelling north from the road east of the Gunnarsgrunn, players can enter the Grand Exchange, and from there the Varrock Palace grounds. An Agility shortcut north-west of the Grand Exchange can be used by members with 21 agility, running two-way between Varrock and Edgeville.
North of Varrock

place.title: Varrock

It is the largest city for non-members and one of largest cities overall.

start_overview: Entrance to The Heart of Gielinor — Kharidian Desert

get_inside.text: Kharidian Desert
The entrance area of The Heart
pic: The entrance area of The Heart

get_inside.text: Using The Heart teleport, which can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern or obtained on the Grand Exchange, is the fastest way to get there. This requires completion of the Tales of the God Wars miniquest to use the teleport tablet.
Using The Heart of Gielinor teleport option on a portal nexus in a player-owned house.
Using Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) to arrive just outside one of the four faction boss chambers or attune the portal to Telos to arrive in the centre.

The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.
Ride the magic carpet to Nardah, then walk west.
Home Teleport to Al Kharid or use the broomstick teleport to the Sorceress's Garden and run south to the Shantay Pass rug merchant.
Teleport to the house portal in Pollnivneach with House Teleport, a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, or a Pollnivneach tablet and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Use the Slayer cape or a Ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone and walk south-east, go over a bridge and walk a bit further east.
Teleport to the Agility Pyramid via the Jaleustrophos option on a Pharaoh's sceptre and head north.
The representatives for each faction can be found in the entrance area of The Heart. These are:
Gregorovic's Chosen, representative for Sliske
Helwyr's Chosen, representative for Seren
Furies' Chosen, representative for Zamorak
Vindicta's Chosen, representative for Zaros
Players can check their reputation with each faction at each of the representatives, as well as reclaim any reputation rewards.

Feng, the Bounty Master is also found in the entrance area. Players can be assigned one bounty a day in a faction to earn reputation. Each bounty requires 100 kills in the assigned faction, with killing the faction's General counting as 25 kills.

Players cannot use their Ingression fragments to summon their monsters at the entrance; this is because the four factions have made a truce in this area as they did not want to be "savages" and wanted to recruit mercenaries at their side.
Soothsayer Sybil is also found in the entrance area, standing next to the entrance to Telos, the Warden's lair. Players can collect loot from her as well as reset Telos's enrage.
Heart of Gielinor

pics: The entrance area of The Heart

place.title: Heart of Gielinor
place.summary: The Heart of Gielinor is a mid-to-high combat area. As with the original God Wars Dungeon, the player must obtain killcount to access each general's chambers, obtained by killing a certain number of soldiers of the respective faction. The only exception to this is Telos, who does not need any killcount (though the player needs to kill the generals of the other factions first).

The entrance to the courtyard.
Falador lodestone - Teleports near the north gate.
Falador Teleport - Teleports to the city square near the north gate. Requires level 37 Magic Magic and an air runes, a water rune, and a law rune. Falador teleport tablet may also be used.

Teleport to South Falador - Teleports to the south gate southern entrance. Unlocked at the Livid Farm, requires level 72 Magic Magic, being on the Lunar Spellbook and two astral runes, a law rune, and two air runes.
Skills necklace - Teleports to the Mining Guild's entrance.
Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) attuned to the giant mole - Teleports to the Falador Park.
Ring of respawn - Teleports to the White Knights' Castle after completion of Recruitment Drive.
Skills necklace or balloon transport system - Teleport to the Crafting Guild south-west of the city, and climb into the underwall tunnel shortcut (requires level 26 Agility Agility).

Falador can be entered through the north gate, which has a road leading to Barbarian Village, and features a variety of guards; from the underground Dwarven Mine (either from the Mining Guild or from a house in the north-eastern neighbourhood of the city); through the south gate near Port Sarim; or by Falador Teleport, a spell which requires level 37 Magic (also requiring a water rune, three air runes, and a law rune). The north and south gates are popular training spots for low level players hoping to level up on guards.

Those with level 5 Agility can also enter from the west by using the Agility shortcut on the crumbling wall on the west side of the city. Members also can enter by crawling under a hole in the southern wall or by using a grapple shortcut to climb over the northern wall.
Grappling

A hidey-hole can be built for the 2-way grapple shortcut over the northern wall located where the shortcut is indicated on the minimap. The hidey-hole is a buildable storage spot to store a crossbow and grapple and eliminates the need to carry a crossbow and grapple to use the shortcut. To construct the hidey-hole, level 29 construction is required, as well as a saw and hammer (the tool belt works), four planks, a bronze crossbow, mithril grapple, and four nails. It requires level 11 Agility, 19 Ranged, and 37 Strength to use.

Falador (IPAc-en | ' | f | æ | l | ə | d | ɔːr Respell-en | FAL-ə-dor ) is the capital of Asgarnia. It serves as the base of operations for the White Knights and Temple Knights, two Saradominist knightly organisations. It has a significant role in the mining and smithing industries, with the south-eastern section of the city being home to both the Mining Guild and the Artisans' Workshop, and a mining dungeon under the eastern half of the city. Falador's population is usually around 40,000, although it swelled to almost 80,000 during the Siege of Falador.

place.title: Ice Mountain
place.summary: Beneath the surface, Ice Mountain is filled with a massive underground network that stretches far beyond the mountain's edges. Both the dwarves of Keldagrim and Imcando dwarves have connected the mountain to the Dwarven Realm, leading to the establishment of subterranean Dwarven Mines, Camdozaal, and the Ice Mountain Dwarven Colony. The Kinshra formerly used the area as a slave mine, although today their only subterranean work on the mountain is in the Black Knights' Catacombs. Even further down is a complex river system where the Living Rock Caverns can be found.

get_inside.text: Karamja
The entrance to Brimhaven Dungeon
The dungeon is located a short distance north-west of the Karamja lodestone. There are also other ways to get there, which are generally obsolete since the introduction of the lodestone:
It be reached by sailing from East Ardougne to Brimhaven, for a fee of 30 coins, 15 with Karamja gloves 1 or for free with the ring of charos.
Another sea route can be taken from Port Sarim to Musa Point, for the same price. However, it is a much longer walk to the dungeon entrance from Musa Point than from Brimhaven.
Alternatively, players can charter a ship to get to Brimhaven (e.g. the Port Sarim-Brimhaven charter ship ride costs 1,600 coins).
Teleportation is also practical:
Players with level 99 Dungeoneering can use the Dungeoneering cape's perk to teleport to the Brimhaven Dungeon resource dungeon after having accessed it first through other means.
House Teleport if the player-owned house is on Karamja or a Brimhaven tablet if the player has completed Love Story.
Teleport to the Karamja lodestone, which is located directly south-east of the dungeon.
Spirit tree if the player can plant a spirit tree behind the Brimhaven Agility Arena.
Amulet of glory to Karamja, then run west then south.
Fairy ring CKR and then north to the dungeon.
Use of Tai Bwo Wannai Teleport scrolls, a reward from Treasure Trails.

The nearest bank, although the quest Shilo Village and 10 extra coins are required, is Shilo Village bank by using Hajedy's cart. However, one would normally teleport to a bank and return via the the Karamja lodestone.

get_inside.text: Wilderness
There are five rifts that allow entrance to the Chaos Tunnels. These are located:
North of the Monastery of Saradomin in level 4 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with gargoyles.
East of the Mage of Zamorak in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with Giant Rock Crabs.
North of the Grand Exchange in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with shadow spiders and crypt spiders.
North of the bridge between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange in level 9 wilderness; enters a cave with moss giants.
North of the Grand Exchange beacon in level 9 wilderness; rift enters a cave with cave bugs.

During the quest What Lies Below, a safe route into the Chaos Tunnels is uncovered. Entering the statue south-west of the Fort Forinthry leads into the Tunnel of Chaos. get_inside.text: Edgeville
There are two entrances to the dungeon. The most common is in Edgeville, in the ruins south of the bank. It is marked by a mark on the minimap.

Another entrance is west of the Cooks' Guild near Varrock on the east side of the River Lum. To get in, the player must bring a brass key which can be found in the dungeon. It is useful to players who wish to collect big bones, since it leads right down to a group of Hill Giants and is fairly close to the Varrock bank. Alternatively, members can use the bank in the Cooking guild, which is nearer, provided they have completed the Hard set of the Varrock tasks.

The fastest way to get here is to use the Annakarl Teleport from the Ancient Magicks spellbook.

Use an Obelisk (Wilderness) to teleport to the obelisk located near the Rogues' Castle in level 50 Wilderness, then run south east through the gate and continue west. She is the final boss of the quest and is the sister of the black stone dragon from the second elite dungeon, the Dragonkin Laboratory. get_inside.text: Travelling to Anachronia for the first time requires the player to use The Stormbreaker, the ship built during the Breaking the Storm event, which is located east of the Varrock Dig Site (). Players can board the ship, located on the river, to visit Anachronia. Players will be shown a cutscene the first time they travel to the island and will have to guide a group of NPCs, including an archaeologist, Laniakea, and two guards, through the island.
Map of routes around Anachronia
Agility course

The primary means of travel across the island is traversing the Anachronia Agility Course. This requires Agility levels 30 to 85 to traverse. The course is divided into seven sections of varying difficulty but requires level 85 Agility to complete the whole lap.
Teleports
Quick methods to teleport across the island are ():
Anachronia lodestone, which can be unlocked using materials after completing a tutorial with Giles at the base camp
Slayer cape to teleport to Laniakea's at the south-east ruins
North-western Anachronia Teleport spell to teleport to the north-western side of Anachronia, near the time altar
Eastern Anachronia Teleport spell to teleport to the eastern side of Anachronia, a short distance to the east of the spirit grove
Anachronia Teleport spell if a Totem of the Abyss is planted and active
Anachronia tablet to teleport to the Player Lodge; it requires the Love Story quest and a tier 2 Player Lodge
Ancient seed to Herby Werby

place.title: Anachronia
place.summary: The island features the player-built base camp, an activity called Big Game Hunter, a weekly Distraction and Diversion called Herby Werby, an island-wide Agility Course, 8 Slayer monsters requiring a Slayer level ranging from 90 to 114 (consisting of plants and dinosaurs), Slayer Master Laniakea, the Orthen Dig Site, and continuation of the story where the Desperate Times quest left off.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: Travelling to Anachronia for the first time requires the player to use The Stormbreaker, the ship built during the Breaking the Storm event, which is located east of the Varrock Dig Site (). Players can board the ship, located on the river, to visit Anachronia. Players will be shown a cutscene the first time they travel to the island and will have to guide a group of NPCs, including an archaeologist, Laniakea, and two guards, through the island.

getting_there.heading: Travel
getting_there.text:
Agility course

The primary means of travel across the island is traversing the Anachronia Agility Course. This requires Agility levels 30 to 85 to traverse. The course is divided into seven sections of varying difficulty but requires level 85 Agility to complete the whole lap.

Teleports

• Anachronia lodestone, which can be unlocked using materials after completing a tutorial with Giles at the base camp

• North-western Anachronia Teleport spell to teleport to the north-western side of Anachronia, near the time altar
• Eastern Anachronia Teleport spell to teleport to the eastern side of Anachronia, a short distance to the east of the spirit grove
• Anachronia Teleport spell if a Totem of the Abyss is planted and active
• Anachronia tablet to teleport to the Player Lodge; it requires the Love Story quest and a tier 2 Player Lodge
• Ancient seed to Herby Werby

• Dig sites map, master archaeologist's outfit or Archaeology teleport to Orthen Dig Site (or to Sharrigan) with 90 Archaeology
• Archaeology journal then run east to the Stormbreaker ship

place.title: Freneskae
place.summary: Once considered a "perfect" world, Freneskae is now a dark wasteland. Its toxic atmosphere is riddled with constant lightning storms, volcanic eruptions and lava flows near its surface of bare rock. In addition to the Mahjarrat, Freneskae was home to the Mahserrat, Mahkorat, and the Chelon-Mah, and is the only world on which muspah and nihil may be found.

Prifddinas (IPAc-en | p | r | ɪ | v | ˈ | θ | iː | n | ə | s Respell-en | priv | THEE | nuss ) is the greatest city of the elves and the capital city of Tirannwn. It is located just north of Isafdar. The city is the oldest surviving settlement on Gielinor, being created in the First Age, when it was made almost entirely of wood with small amounts of crystal. It has since been reshaped and is now composed entirely from crystals by Seren and Tarddiad. Due to the Elven Civil War, the entire city was reverted to crystal seed form, but it is reformed during the Plague's End quest. As such, Plague's End is a requirement to visit the city.

Mort Myre Swamp, once a forest known as Humblethorn, is a swampland in western Morytania. It is a place plagued by Ghasts. get_inside.text: Using The Heart teleport, which can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern or obtained on the Grand Exchange, is the fastest way to get there. This requires completion of the Tales of the God Wars miniquest to use the teleport tablet.
Using The Heart of Gielinor teleport option on a portal nexus in a player-owned house.
Using Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) to arrive just outside one of the four faction boss chambers or attune the portal to Telos to arrive in the centre.

The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.
Ride the magic carpet to Nardah, then walk west.
Home Teleport to Al Kharid or use the broomstick teleport to the Sorceress's Garden and run south to the Shantay Pass rug merchant.
Teleport to the house portal in Pollnivneach with House Teleport, a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, or a Pollnivneach tablet and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Use the Slayer cape or a Ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone and walk south-east, go over a bridge and walk a bit further east.
Teleport to the Agility Pyramid via the Jaleustrophos option on a Pharaoh's sceptre and head north.
The representatives for each faction can be found in the entrance area of The Heart. These are:
Gregorovic's Chosen, representative for Sliske
Helwyr's Chosen, representative for Seren
Furies' Chosen, representative for Zamorak
Vindicta's Chosen, representative for Zaros
Players can check their reputation with each faction at each of the representatives, as well as reclaim any reputation rewards.

Feng, the Bounty Master is also found in the entrance area. Players can be assigned one bounty a day in a faction to earn reputation. Each bounty requires 100 kills in the assigned faction, with killing the faction's General counting as 25 kills.

Players cannot use their Ingression fragments to summon their monsters at the entrance; this is because the four factions have made a truce in this area as they did not want to be "savages" and wanted to recruit mercenaries at their side.
Soothsayer Sybil is also found in the entrance area, standing next to the entrance to Telos, the Warden's lair. Players can collect loot from her as well as reset Telos's enrage.

The northernmost tunnel entrance is in Canifis, through the trapdoor south of the tavern. For those claimed the shortcut reward for training Zachory Bragg to level 99, they can be deactivated the reward by reading the Temple Trekking noticeboard near Paterdomus and selecting the "reward" option on the Zachory's level 99 "Shortcut" reward.
The tunnel entrance at the southern end of the northern section is in Mort Myre Swamp, through the wooden doors south of the tavern.
The southern tunnel entrance is in north-eastern Meiyerditch in the third building from the top along the eastern wall.
The following are other alternative ways to get to there:
Drakan's medallion can teleport players to the laboratory.
The southern tunnel entrance is in north-eastern Meiyerditch in the third building from the top along the eastern wall.
Fairy ring code DLS transports a player to the north-west corner of the tunnels.
Another quick way to get to this tunnels is to go into the abyss, then through the blood altar and exit it to appear in the cave. However, travelling through the abyss will drain a player's prayer.
Use a blood altar teleport tablet to blood altar.
A mask of Broken Fingers or its upgraded version can teleport players to these tunnels twice per day, near the zombie hands.
A mask of Crimson or its upgraded version can teleport players to these tunnels twice per day, near the aggressive mutated bloodvelds.

Players can travel between different sections through the basement wall and then immediately head east through the cave entrance to Ivandis' tomb. Go through the south cave entrance into the tunnels. It requires Agility level 65 to pass through the jutting wall shortcut.

Attempting the north cave entrance before completing the quest In Aid of the Myreque gives the message: You're not sure where this leads to and have an ominous feeling it leads nowhere good. You decide not to go through.

get_inside.text: Wilderness
There are five rifts that allow entrance to the Chaos Tunnels. These are located:
North of the Monastery of Saradomin in level 4 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with gargoyles.
East of the Mage of Zamorak in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with Giant Rock Crabs.
North of the Grand Exchange in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with shadow spiders and crypt spiders.
North of the bridge between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange in level 9 wilderness; enters a cave with moss giants.
North of the Grand Exchange beacon in level 9 wilderness; rift enters a cave with cave bugs.

During the quest What Lies Below, a safe route into the Chaos Tunnels is uncovered. Entering the statue south-west of the Fort Forinthry leads into the Tunnel of Chaos. From there, the nearest portal to the entrance, towards the north-west, can be used to teleport in to the south-east corner of the Chaos tunnels, a chamber containing giant ant soldiers.

The aggressive monsters can attack players, but players cannot retaliate unless the monster is part of the assignment. The ferocious ring can be obtained as a drop from these monsters, which has multiple passive effects when equipped while inside the dungeon.

• Use Fairy ring code BJQ to teleport to the Ancient Cavern. Partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the fairy rings, and the ring in the cavern must first be repaired before it can be used. This is done by using 5 bittercap mushrooms and a spade on the inner ring.

get_inside.text: Using the magic carpet network to one of two magic carpet stations in the city. South Pollnivneach is also one of the two destinations of the Monkey colony magic carpet route.
House Teleport, if players have their house portal in Pollnivneach, they can use the spell to reach their house and then exit through the portal.
Pollnivneach tablet, if the Love Story quest has been completed.
Ring of slaying, Slayer cape or Slayer master cape teleport to the house of slayer master Sumona.
The Mask of Mourning and Helm of Keening can teleport user to the Pollnivneach well.
The master camouflage outfit offers unlimited teleports to Pollnivneach, just north-east of the well.
Walking south/south-east from the Shantay Pass.
Using the ferryman, Portmaster Kags, in the south-western corner of the Menaphos Port district.
Other ways to reach the city indirectly. These methods first go to nearby locations to speed up the journey, and then use the above methods to reach Pollnivneach:

There are some fairy rings somewhat near Pollnivneach. Ring DLQ is in the Uzer Hunter area near Nardah; from there either use the Nardah carpet or walk north-west to the upper river bridge, cross it and then walk south-west to the city. Ring BIQ is near the entrance to the Kalphite Lair; from there use the Shantay Pass carpet or walk east/south-east to the city.

The eagle transport system flies to a cave near the Uzer Hunter area, like the fairy ring DLQ. From there, either walk south-east to Uzer and use the carpet, or walk south-west to the upper river bridge, cross it and walk south-west to Pollnivneach.
The Dorgesh-Kaan shortcut in the dungeon beneath the agility course leads to the Kalphite Lair and from there has the same routes as Fairy Ring code BIQ.
The camulet from Enakhra's Lament teleports to the underground Enakhra's Temple. Climb out from there and walk east to the city.

The Pharaoh's sceptre from the Pyramid Plunder minigame teleports to any of three pyramids: Jalsavrah Pyramid is in Sophanem; from there take the carpet or walk north to Pollnivneach. Jaleustrophos Pyramid is the Agility Pyramid; from there either walk northeast to Nardah and take the carpet, or walk north-west to the lower river bridge, cross it and walk north to Pollnivneach. Jaldraocht Pyramid is also called Azzanadra's pyramid from the Desert Treasure quest; from there walk east or northeast to Pollnivneach.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Pollnivneach Teleport scroll takes user directly into the city.
• Using the magic carpet network to one of two magic carpet stations in the city. South Pollnivneach is also one of the two destinations of the Monkey colony magic carpet route.
• House Teleport, if players have their house portal in Pollnivneach, they can use the spell to reach their house and then exit through the portal.
• Pollnivneach tablet, if the Love Story quest has been completed.
• Ring of slaying, Slayer cape or Slayer master cape teleport to the house of slayer master Sumona.
• The Mask of Mourning and Helm of Keening can teleport user to the Pollnivneach well.
• The master camouflage outfit offers unlimited teleports to Pollnivneach, just north-east of the well.
• Walking south/south-east from the Shantay Pass.
• Using the ferryman, Portmaster Kags, in the south-western corner of the Menaphos Port district.

Other ways to reach the city indirectly. These methods first go to nearby locations to speed up the journey, and then use the above methods to reach Pollnivneach:
• There are some fairy rings somewhat near Pollnivneach. Ring DLQ is in the Uzer Hunter area near Nardah; from there either use the Nardah carpet or walk north-west to the upper river bridge, cross it and then walk south-west to the city. Ring BIQ is near the entrance to the Kalphite Lair; from there use the Shantay Pass carpet or walk east/south-east to the city.
• The eagle transport system flies to a cave near the Uzer Hunter area, like the fairy ring DLQ. From there, either walk south-east to Uzer and use the carpet, or walk south-west to the upper river bridge, cross it and walk south-west to Pollnivneach.
• The Dorgesh-Kaan shortcut in the dungeon beneath the agility course leads to the Kalphite Lair and from there has the same routes as Fairy Ring code BIQ.
• The camulet from Enakhra's Lament teleports to the underground Enakhra's Temple. Climb out from there and walk east to the city.
• The Pharaoh's sceptre from the Pyramid Plunder minigame teleports to any of three pyramids: Jalsavrah Pyramid is in Sophanem; from there take the carpet or walk north to Pollnivneach. Jaleustrophos Pyramid is the Agility Pyramid; from there either walk northeast to Nardah and take the carpet, or walk north-west to the lower river bridge, cross it and walk north to Pollnivneach. Jaldraocht Pyramid is also called Azzanadra's pyramid from the Desert Treasure quest; from there walk east or northeast to Pollnivneach.

get_inside.text: Southeast of the Rellekka Hunter area

The Brine Rat Cavern is in the north-eastern region of the Fremennik Province. There are multiple ways to travel to the cavern. One of the quickest ways is to use the fairy ring, code DKS. Alternatively, a player may use the Fremennik Province lodestone and run northeast. Mask or helm of the Frozen Wyrm twice a day to teleport into the Ice strykewyrm cave. From there, exit the cave and you will emerge close to the windswept tree.

place.title: Brine Rat Cavern
place.summary: The Brine Rat Cavern is a series of caverns which feature heavily in Olaf's Quest, and cannot be accessed beforehand. It can be entered after starting the quest by digging deep snow south of the windswept tree. The entrance is located on a plateau east of Olaf Hradson and southeast of the Rellekka Hunter area. After digging the deep snow, the player will be stunned for a few seconds and emerge in the southwestern section of the cavern.

get_inside.text: Lunar Sea
The ring of Wealth or higher tier luck rings can be used to teleport next to Advisor Ghrim, which is useful for those who do Managing Miscellania, but requires completion of Throne of Miscellania.

A Miscellania teleport scroll can be used to teleport to the square of Miscellania. They can be bought from the Grand Exchange or obtained from clue scrolls. These scrolls can only be used upon completion of The Fremennik Trials.

There is a boat run by the Sailor on the second westernmost dock in Rellekka which can be used to travel to Miscellania but requires completion of The Fremennik Trials to use. The enchanted lyre can be used to teleport to Rellekka. The Fremennik Province lodestone (Alt+F while interface is open) is just east of Rellekka. A side entrance to Rellekka is available north-west of the lodestone.

Fairy ring code CIP will teleport players west of the mine on Miscellania. The code only works on completion of The Fremennik Trials, otherwise the rings treat the code as unrecognised and teleport you just a few spaces from the main ring.

get_inside.text: Karamja
The entrance to Brimhaven Dungeon
The dungeon is located a short distance north-west of the Karamja lodestone. There are also other ways to get there, which are generally obsolete since the introduction of the lodestone:
It be reached by sailing from East Ardougne to Brimhaven, for a fee of 30 coins, 15 with Karamja gloves 1 or for free with the ring of charos.
Another sea route can be taken from Port Sarim to Musa Point, for the same price. However, it is a much longer walk to the dungeon entrance from Musa Point than from Brimhaven.
Alternatively, players can charter a ship to get to Brimhaven (e.g. the Port Sarim-Brimhaven charter ship ride costs 1,600 coins).
Teleportation is also practical:
Players with level 99 Dungeoneering can use the Dungeoneering cape's perk to teleport to the Brimhaven Dungeon resource dungeon after having accessed it first through other means.
House Teleport if the player-owned house is on Karamja or a Brimhaven tablet if the player has completed Love Story.
Teleport to the Karamja lodestone, which is located directly south-east of the dungeon.
Spirit tree if the player can plant a spirit tree behind the Brimhaven Agility Arena.
Amulet of glory to Karamja, then run west then south.
Fairy ring CKR and then north to the dungeon.
Use of Tai Bwo Wannai Teleport scrolls, a reward from Treasure Trails.

The nearest bank, although the quest Shilo Village and 10 extra coins are required, is Shilo Village bank by using Hajedy's cart. However, one would normally teleport to a bank and return via the the Karamja lodestone.

get_inside.text: Wilderness
There are five rifts that allow entrance to the Chaos Tunnels. These are located:
North of the Monastery of Saradomin in level 4 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with gargoyles.
East of the Mage of Zamorak in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with Giant Rock Crabs.
North of the Grand Exchange in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with shadow spiders and crypt spiders.
North of the bridge between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange in level 9 wilderness; enters a cave with moss giants.
North of the Grand Exchange beacon in level 9 wilderness; rift enters a cave with cave bugs.

During the quest What Lies Below, a safe route into the Chaos Tunnels is uncovered. Entering the statue south-west of the Fort Forinthry leads into the Tunnel of Chaos. From there, the nearest portal to the entrance, towards the north-west, can be used to teleport in to the south-east corner of the Chaos tunnels, a chamber containing giant ant soldiers.

ml.name: Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup
ml.text: Broodoo victims are undead creatures which appear during Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup, but appear rarer than other monsters. They can be found while cutting light, medium, or dense jungle bushes. Their attack is capable of draining the player's combat stats. They take reduced damage from the player's attacks, but have low life points and can usually be defeated easily. Certain items can be used on them to damage them, but is not recommended as it is time-consuming, unless the player is of a low combat level: blue broodoo victims can be damaged by food items; green victims by antipoison; and orange victims finally by a dose of Relicym's balm.

Mort Myre Swamp, once a forest known as Humblethorn, is a swampland in western Morytania. It is a place plagued by Ghasts. Therefore, not even a full inventory of food will keep players safe here, because ghasts will decompose any kind of food. It is highly recommended for a player to carry a druid pouch with them as they travel through here. It can only be obtained during the Nature Spirit quest. Completing the quest is also a requirement to gain access to the gate shortcut. Dwarf multicannons cannot be set up in this area.

get_inside.text: Baxtorian Lake

The whirlpool entrance to the Ancient Cavern is south of the Barbarian Outpost, at the head of the River Dougne, above Baxtorian Falls. Players can get there by walking west from Seers' Village, north from East Ardougne, or east from the Tree Gnome Stronghold. (From the Stronghold, players with level 37 Agility can take the shortcut northeast of the Grand Tree; otherwise, the more round-about route through the Stronghold's southern gate is necessary.)
Some teleports can be used to get near the whirlpool:
A games necklace can teleport to the Barbarian Outpost. This is quickest way to get to the whirlpool, as it is just south of the Outpost.
A combat bracelet can teleport to the Ranging Guild, which is east of Baxtorian Falls.
Barbarian Teleport from the Lunar Spellbook. Teleporting between the Barbarian Outpost and Lunar Isle provides quick banking during slayer tasks.
A plain of mud sphere can teleport one near the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
A skills necklace can teleport to the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
Players with level 37 Agility can use the gnome gliders or spirit trees to travel to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and then use the shortcut north of the Grand Tree to get to the Baxtorian Falls lake.
Three teleports can be used to directly enter the dungeon:
Fairy ring code BJQ, which will teleport near the north-western most waterfiends, once it is repaired as described earlier.

The ferocious ring, which is a drop from the creatures in Kuradal's Dungeon, can teleport the player to Kuradal (Note: you can only attack the monsters in the dungeon if they are your current Slayer assignment assigned by Kuradal, Morvran, or Laniakea.)
The Slayer cape can be used to teleport the player to Kuradal.

get_inside.text: Unquiet Ocean
There are many ways to travel to, from, and within Karamja.
Ship

A popular way to travel for free players is by ship from Port Sarim by talking to the men in front of the ship (first ship you come across heading east from the Port Sarim Lodestone), which costs 30gp for the trip. This can be reduced to 15gp, if you're a member, by completing the easy Karamja achievements, and completely free by using the Ring of charos(a). Another ship route is available from the Ardougne Docks to Brimhaven. Players who wish to travel by boat will have their inventories searched by customs officers, as the law prohibits individuals from carrying rum off the island. Those who wish to circumvent this and smuggle rum to the mainland may find it helpful to check the guide for the Pirate's Treasure quest, where the player must smuggle Karamja rum.

get_inside.text: Using The Heart teleport, which can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern or obtained on the Grand Exchange, is the fastest way to get there. This requires completion of the Tales of the God Wars miniquest to use the teleport tablet.
Using The Heart of Gielinor teleport option on a portal nexus in a player-owned house.
Using Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) to arrive just outside one of the four faction boss chambers or attune the portal to Telos to arrive in the centre.

The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.
Ride the magic carpet to Nardah, then walk west.
Home Teleport to Al Kharid or use the broomstick teleport to the Sorceress's Garden and run south to the Shantay Pass rug merchant.
Teleport to the house portal in Pollnivneach with House Teleport, a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, or a Pollnivneach tablet and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Use the Slayer cape or a Ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone and walk south-east, go over a bridge and walk a bit further east.
Teleport to the Agility Pyramid via the Jaleustrophos option on a Pharaoh's sceptre and head north.
The representatives for each faction can be found in the entrance area of The Heart. These are:
Gregorovic's Chosen, representative for Sliske
Helwyr's Chosen, representative for Seren
Furies' Chosen, representative for Zamorak
Vindicta's Chosen, representative for Zaros
Players can check their reputation with each faction at each of the representatives, as well as reclaim any reputation rewards.

Feng, the Bounty Master is also found in the entrance area. Players can be assigned one bounty a day in a faction to earn reputation. Each bounty requires 100 kills in the assigned faction, with killing the faction's General counting as 25 kills.

Players cannot use their Ingression fragments to summon their monsters at the entrance; this is because the four factions have made a truce in this area as they did not want to be "savages" and wanted to recruit mercenaries at their side.
Soothsayer Sybil is also found in the entrance area, standing next to the entrance to Telos, the Warden's lair. Players can collect loot from her as well as reset Telos's enrage.
